Lohardaga.

Learned counsel for the petitioner produces a copy of mediation proceeding dated 1st August, 2024 conducted at Mediation Centre, Lohardaga in Mediation Case No.152 of 2024 arising out of OMC No.26 of 2024 and submits that it has been agreed by the parties that the petitioner would pay the amount of one time settlement in five monthly instalments and the 1st instalment of Rs.1,90,000/- was to be paid to the opposite party no.2 through NEFT by 5th August, 2024.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in view of the said one time settlement, the 1st instalment has already been paid to the opposite party no.2 on 5th August, 2024.
So far as the 2nd instalment is concerned, the same has been delayed by few days, however, it will be paid to the opposite party no.2 within one or two days.
It is further submitted that the petitioner duly undertakes to abide by the terms and conditions of the settlement.
4. Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 accepts the fact that the petitioner has paid the 1st instalment of Rs.1,90,000/- to the opposite party no.2 on 5th August, 2024.

5. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering that the petitioner and the opposite party no.2 have amicably settled the dispute through Mediation Case No.152 of 2024 arising out of OMC No.26 of 2024, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on anticipatory bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, above named, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the court below within three weeks from today, shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Lohardaga in connection with Lohardaga P.S. Case No.257 of 2023 subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
6.
Let a copy of the proceeding of Mediation Case No.152 of 2024 arising out of OMC No.26 of 2024 be kept on record.

(Rajesh Shankar, J.) Vikas/
